summary: Domain-Driven Design architecture for knowledge, issues, executors and knowledge transfer
Offline RAG core using small local embedding, LLM and LVM models
Ingest and process DOC, DOCX and PDF files
Define the organizational layers and the organizations and nodes in each layer
Let each layer define the knowledge it needs from its children
Use AI to improve, shorten, expand and summarize knowledge, and to suggest the detail level for transfer upward
Model completed projects, research, achievements, challenges, unsolved issues and research gaps
Keep very detailed knowledge in lower layers and transfer a suitable level of detail upward
Support an offline request from the upper layer for the latest prepared information
Process each node's knowledge in cycles and store the latest transferable output as CSV or in a local database
Issue decomposition, sub-issues, issue comparison and the Issue-Knowledge-Executor model
Produce a probable answer or solution for issues from the node's knowledge
Determine issue status and progress percentage
Identify and prioritize key issues and research gaps
Generate RFPs, manage proposals, evaluate proposals and generate automatic feedback
Support metadata with issue definition and knowledge registration
Treat the system architecture and the Issue-Knowledge-Executor model as knowledge of each node
Support knowledge in any field of activity
Update, version, chunk, compare and de-duplicate knowledge
Define clear indicators to evaluate each main component, reviewed with the supervisor
